description:
A threat actor dubbed Gheist is turning compromised GitHub accounts into credential-harvesting platforms. By planting malicious GitHub Actions workflows in private repositories, attackers can expose repository and environment secrets, then retrieve them through GitHub APIs before deleting evidence of the activity.

Tracked since September 15 by Wiz Research, the campaign has left more than 13,500 malicious branches across over 850 compromised accounts, spanning personal projects and private enterprise repositories.

title: Gheist turns GitHub Actions into a secret extraction service

description:
Oracle on Tuesday said it has partnered with Snowflake to make the latter’s AI Data Cloud available as a native service on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).

The partnership, announced at Oracle’s ongoing AI World conference, aims to help enterprises reduce data movement between the two platforms and the associated costs while accelerating analytics and AI workloads, the companies said in a joint statement.

That means enterprises with data stored in Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications, NetSuite, Oracle Autonomous AI Database, MySQL HeatWave, and Oracle NoSQL Database will be able to access Snowflak
title: Oracle adds native Snowflake service to OCI to ease data integration

description:
While many organizations are in early AI agent rollouts, research suggests that more will scale to greater numbers of agents and assistants in the coming year. An August 2026 report states that 66% of enterprises are likely to invest in digital workers in the next 12 months. It reports that the top requirements for these agents include demonstrated accuracy, clear explanations around decisions, and human override capabilities.

A security research firm reported Monday that it had identified breaches of 42 third-party GitHub repositories in which attackers had deployed payload blobs large enough “to evade the GitHub search and API paths normally used to find this kind of compromise.”
